system.description:
• Effect: Once a round, as no action, while an invisible creature or object is within 30ft, make an Intelligence check to sense (not see) its location and movement.
  • 18th level: a success also shows its shape and size
  • 24th level: you permanently see all things as the True Seeing spell, with no check

activities.name: See Invisible
activities.text: Perceive the general location and movement of an invisible creature or object within 30ft.
